mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_conversation (user_id, title, database_type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{databaseType})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, database_type, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_conversation SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_conversation WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (conversation_id, role, content, sql_text, query_plan_json, response_json) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sqlText}, #{queryPlanJson}, #{responseJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, conversation_id, role, content, sql_text, query_plan_json, response_json, created_at FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
